data.headline: Q2 revenue fell as development sales remain approval-dependent

claims.text: Q2 2026 revenue was $19,361,000, down 54.0% year over year from $42,054,000.

claims.text: Future sales of parcels at Asbury Park Waterfront and Magnolia Green depend on approvals from local municipalities.

citation.quote: Future sales of parcels at Asbury Park Waterfront and Magnolia Green will be subject to receipt of approvals from local municipalities.

claims.text: The company says approval requirements can change and approvals may not arrive timely or at all.

citation.quote: The requirements we will need to fulfill to obtain such approvals are subject to change. We may not receive such approvals in a timely manner or at all.

claims.text: Its current Asbury Park strategy is to monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.
